name: week
title: Rebates this week
subtitle: What needs doing, who is close to a tier, and what is waiting on payment

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind, account, item, detail from (select 'calculate' as kind,account,agreement as item,'Settle by '||settle_by as detail from to_calculate union all select 'pay',account,agreement,state||', settle by '||settle_by from payout_queue where settle_by<=current_date+7 union all select 'claim',account,reference,finding from unmatched_claims where finding<>'Ready to match' union all select 'agreement',account,agreement,issue from agreement_watch union all select 'rule',account,record,issue from compliance_gaps) x order by kind, account

sections.title: Tier progress this period
sections.note: Projected is the period's total at the current pace.
sections.sql: select account, agreement, currency, days_left, measure, rate, earned_to_date, next_threshold, gap_to_next, projected from tier_progress order by account

sections.title: Waiting on approval or payment
sections.sql: select account, agreement, period_start, total, state, settle_by from payout_queue order by settle_by

sections.title: Claims to resolve
sections.sql: select account, reference, claimed_on, amount, settled, finding, days_open from unmatched_claims order by days_open desc

name: month-end
title: Rebate accrual
subtitle: What the business owes on rebates today, for the month-end journal

sections.title: Liability by agreement
sections.sql: select account, agreement, currency, settled_unpaid, not_yet_calculated, open_period_to_date, liability from accruals order by liability desc

sections.title: Total by currency
sections.sql: select currency, sum(liability) as liability from accruals group by currency order by currency

sections.title: Rebate cost, last 12 months
sections.sql: select a.name as account, coalesce(sum(s.total),0) as rebates_paid from accounts a join agreements g on g.account_id=a.id left join settlements s on s.agreement_id=g.id and s.state='paid' and s.paid_on>current_date-365 group by a.name order by rebates_paid desc

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select rule, account, record, issue, source from compliance_gaps order by rule
